subject: textarea can't handle special characters when you set Sys.setlocale(locale="C")

messages.author: f48eb9df47d17d69
messages.subject: textarea can't handle special characters when you set Sys.setlocale(locale="C")
parts:
I use DataTables in my app, and I used to get lots of weird javascript errors when certain non-alphanumeric characters were in the tables or entered in the search boxes. 

The setting Sys.setlocale(locale="C") was recommended on stackoverflow as a workaround, but generates another problem - entering text into textarea can cause crashes. What do?

###
### code for minimum reproducible example
###

library(shiny) 
Sys.setlocale(locale="C")
runApp(list( 
  ui=fluidPage(tags$textarea( 
    id="text", rows=10, cols=80, "try entering some special characters, for example three single quotation marks. this will crash with a JSON input error" 
  )), 
  server=function(input,output){ 
    observe(print(input$text)) 
  } 
)) 

###
### output when sourced
###

> runApp(list( 
+   ui=fluidPage(tags$textarea( 
+     id="text", rows=10, cols=80, "try entering some special characters, for example three single qu ..." ... [TRUNCATED]

[1] "try entering some special characters, for example three single quotation marks. this will crash with a JSON input error"
### while the app is running i entered the three quotation marks

  invalid JSON input

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: textarea can't handle special characters when you set Sys.setlocale(locale="C")
parts:
I don't know why the C locale was recommended (could you give a link
to the SO post?). On the contrary, I'd recommend you to avoid C. You
current locale en_US.UTF-8 is better at handling non-ASCII characters,
so what we really need to do is to fix the DataTables issue, which has
probably gone with the new DT package (http://rstudio.github.io/DT/)
but I can certainly try to fix the to-be-deprecated versions of
renderDataTable()/dataTableOutput() in shiny.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: textarea can't handle special characters when you set Sys.setlocale(locale="C")
parts:
Thanks for the quick response. I don't have time right now to make a minimum working example of the DataTables issue that induced me to use locale='C', but I can tell you what happens in the table I have in my app.

The issue is, when I enter a string into the filter box (any string - no special characters), I get this error in shiny:

Error in tolower(x) : invalid multibyte string 664

and this error in DataTables:

DataTables warning: table id=DataTables_Table_2 - Ajax error. For more information about this error, please see http://datatables.net/tn/7

These errors do not occur when the locale='C' option is used.

It looks like shiny is trying to convert the table data to lowercase to enable case insensitive matching, but it's choking on some odd characters in the data table.

probably gone with the new DT package (http://rstudio.github.io/DT/)
but I can certainly try to fix the to-be-deprecated versions of
renderDataTable()/dataTableOutput() in shiny.

Regards,
Yihui

development to the DT package: http://rstudio.github.io/DT/ I was able
to reproduce your problem, and fixed it in DT.

Regards,
Yihui
